basis: Official binary1.3.0 and its release-target source/dependency commits; all listed critical constants confirmed in release-matched sources. Binary SHA pins actual executable; not rebuilt locally.
PageRank_personalization: native node weights; native combined-edge weights
native_PageRank_node_exclusion: nodes with no incoming neighbors in the native graph are not exported as ranked nodes
native_output_absent_condition_values: native rank table writer may fill absent condition nodes with0; this study requires finite positive ranks in both conditions and does not convert0 to epsilon
native_HTML_only_filters: FDR0.001 and max/min ratio>2 are display filters after full GeneRanks.tsv output; they are not applied to this study's full gene-level priority table
study_priority: max(PR_target/PR_source,PR_source/PR_target), both strictly positive finite; no ratio cutoff, epsilon, cocktail enumeration or frequency score
RNA_over_ATAC_expression_precedence: Core.aggregate uses RNA expression whenever provided; BAM-derived estimated expression is only a fallback
